plan.hypothesis: The normal ROM registry recent-cache hit is an out-of-line WASM call in compiled-chain dispatch. Inline only the existing positive-hit path, leaving map recovery out of line; preserve all keys and lifetime behavior. Force the surrounding lookup inline too: inspection of the first prototype found LLVM/Binaryen had outlined lookup_compiled_impl, preserving a handoff on positive hits.
plan.decision_rule: Adopt only an exact-replay-passing useful improvement repeated in both orders; gains below roughly 3 percent or mixed directions count toward diminishing returns. A small Snakes tradeoff may be accepted for a larger repeatable Sky Force gain. Stop this campaign after two independent high-priority follow-ups fail to establish a useful gain, unless new profiles show a stronger concrete target.
